title: Two Weathers
summary: Start: enter the system. The log opens Two Weathers and the helm marks Hot Face. Do: Close on Hot Face. The Weather Shepherd walks the terminator pocket. Ember kale wants the hot face. Ghost gourd wants the cold face. Finish: come inside Hot Face's shell. The Charter writes standing. The pocket is the claim slot. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close.
